texts: Why does the Council redistribute mire-essence reserves?

fields.sentence: Why does the Council redistribute mire-essence reserves?

review.notes: "the Council" is a singular collective noun and a bare capitalized class word, so the plain Agent event with kind binding and no Name atom and no distribution rule is right. Redistributing displaces rather than alters its object, so Theme, and the kind-level bare-plural object stays a bare class symbol.
